issue: Historical D19 spans two distinct questions. A shared combined evidence-guide example was displayed under the modern recognition route even though its laptop ownership scenario was never part of that question.

separate_prospective_dimensions.observable: How rewarding genuine recognition is in itself, conditional on the relationship or contribution recognized, without practical payoff.
separate_prospective_dimensions.possible_evidence: A self-reported difference between admiration from close people and admiration from strangers, after practical benefits are explicitly excluded.
must_not_infer: desire to own or control a laptop
being invited to a role on the basis of recognized ability
ambition, narcissism, insecurity, prestige seeking or diagnosis

separate_prospective_dimensions.observable: Motivation to own a regularly available equivalent tool when access, privacy, cost and software restrictions have been controlled.
separate_prospective_dimensions.possible_evidence: Reported desire for permanence, exclusive agency or control independent of practical access, while preserving the individual's explanation.
must_not_infer: intrinsic satisfaction from recognition or praise
the tool or household arrangement is objectively optimal

prospective_A0_observation_split: whether alone time is proactively arranged
whether invitations are accepted or declined when enjoying solitude
source_preservation: The historical D19 entry and all participant answers remain unchanged; only modern display and versioned research item definitions change.
